description: Keep the cross-sections at the ends of the path parallel to the construction plane.
notes: Not available in 7.0: Not listed in the official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index. (https://docs.itascacg.com/flac3d700/contents.html)
In 7.0 the extrusion path is managed through 'extrude segment' commands (add / origin / delete / index / list) rather than a 'path' noun.
